about: The Firefly's own sounds. The voice ("Autocraft Firefly", made with Voice Design, eleven_ttv_v3) is the buggy's driver: a wild, gleeful pyromaniac speed freak, higher, faster and giddier than the Ranger, the Comet, the Prospector and the Juggernaut, on his cockpit radio; its lines go through comm.py like theirs. Ids match the game's sound names (sfx/<name>_<n>): vfirefly = reports in, fireflydeath = death cry (the blast plays with it), flame = one burst of the flamethrower (every 1.79 s, heard where the Firefly stands), fireflymove = a driven Firefly's engine as it pulls away (at most every 2 s, in your ear).

entries.text: [rapid, gleeful] Tank's full! Who wants a tan?

entries.prompt: vehicle-mounted flamethrower fires one short burst: a whoomp of ignition, a roaring jet of fire under a second long, then it sputters out, close up
single burst from a heavy flamethrower, pressurised fuel hiss igniting into a loud fiery roar that licks out and cuts off with a crackle, close up
short blast of a napalm flamethrower, deep whoosh of flame rushing out, crackling fire, quick cutoff with a pop of the valve
light armed dune buggy guns its engine and pulls away fast: high-revving combustion engine snarl rising, gear change, tyres scrabbling on dirt, close up
fast attack buggy accelerating hard from a standstill, raspy turbo engine revs up and roars, gravel spitting from the wheels, heard from the driver's seat
sci-fi hot-rod buggy launches off: sharp engine rev, whine of a turbine, the engine climbing through the revs as it speeds away, close up
